bibl.title: Demosthenes, not Callimachus! P.Oxy. 2258, Unidentified Fragment 11
bibl.seg: Claudio Meliadò, Demosthenes, not Callimachus! P.Oxy. 2258, Unidentified Fragment 11.
bibl.note: P. Oxy. XX, 2258 (= MP3 186; LDAB 523) is one of the most renowned papyri of Callimachus. Demonstrates that one of the scraps published among the Unidentified Fragments, which contains marginal annotations, actually originates from a Demosthenes codex.
